Package io.github.mikestitt.corbelsflightlog

Class WpiLogWriter

java.lang.Object
io.github.mikestitt.corbelsflightlog.WpiLogWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class WpiLogWriter extends Object implements Closeable
Minimal writer for WPILib's WPILOG 1.0 binary log format -- the format AdvantageScope opens.

Written from WPILib's published specification, allwpilib/datalog/doc/datalog.adoc. The format in brief:

  • A header: "WPILOG", version 0x0100, and an optional free-text "extra header".
  • Then records. Each is a one-byte bitfield giving the byte lengths of the three fields that follow -- entry ID (1-4 bytes), payload size (1-4) and timestamp in microseconds (1-8) -- then the payload. Everything is little-endian, and each field uses as few bytes as its value needs.
  • Entry ID 0 is reserved for control records. A Start control record names an entry and gives its type ("double", "string", ...) and must come before any data for it.

Not thread-safe: call from the OpMode thread only.
